requests.title: Frequently Asked Questions
requests.subtitle: Didn't find an answer? Contact us through the contact page, and we'll reply.

items.label: Can ATS systems read my resume?
items.content: Yes, absolutely. Every template is generated as a text-based PDF with standard section headers, ensuring applicant tracking systems (ATS) can parse and recognize your content correctly.

items.label: How can I tailor my resume to a specific job vacancy?
items.content: Create a new resume or upload an existing one to the platform. Based on your information, the platform will automatically adapt your resume to match the job requirements.

items.label: Can I use the platform without a paid subscription?
items.content: Of course. Creating, editing, and viewing are always free — including 5 AI generations and 1 job tailoring per month. The Pro plan is only required for PDF downloads, premium templates, and unlimited AI. You can cancel anytime.

items.label: Which languages does the platform support?
items.content: Currently, Uzbek, Russian, and English are supported — both the interface and resume content work seamlessly across all three languages. You can keep multiple language versions within a single profile and choose which one to send based on the role.

items.label: Can I edit the content generated by AI?
items.content: Yes, you have full control. The AI creates an initial draft — the rest is up to you: you can directly edit any section or bullet point in the text fields.

items.label: Is my data secure, and where is it stored?
items.content: Your content is securely stored in our database linked to your account. You can delete any resume at any time, and deleting your account permanently removes all associated data.

items.label: Can I save multiple resumes?
items.content: Yes, without any limits. You can create a separate version for each job position and adapt the title and work experience to match that specific role.
